method: Each page read in a browser session on 2026-09-24; figures are that page's own structured data (its count, p25, p50 and p75, in USD), not its displayed text.

washington_dc.why: The 2026-08-04 capture read levels.fyi's 'washington-usa' page, which is Washington STATE, not Washington DC: its heading reads 'Software Engineer Salary in Washington, US', it names no DC place, and on 2026-09-24 its figures (median $250,000 from 7,543 submissions, p25 $187,156, p75 $330,000) are the Greater Seattle Area's (median $250,000 from 7,490 submissions, p25 $189K, p75 $330K). Washington DC's page on levels.fyi is 'northern-virginia-washington-dc' (heading 'Software Engineer Salary in Northern Virginia Washington DC, US') - the page this city's own market band already cites. The other 16 levels.fyi-sourced cities' pages were checked the same day and are the right places.
